_note: Confirmatory E2 (docs/preregistration-draft.md §3.3, §4.4, §6). To be frozen with the preregistration. Read by scripts/e2_map.py (lambdas, reps, min_feature_count, bootstrap_persons; run with --d2-from-config) and scripts/e2_summarise.py (the rest). bootstrap_persons: each rep resamples the persons with replacement (strata: A) before the permutation and the CV (判断 18); false reproduces the earlier development runs. alpha_one_sided: the level of the Holm-adjusted one-sided p of H1 and H2 (判断 17). 判断 25: the primary estimator is dV_bal (balanced accuracy, p > 0.5; dV_acc and dV_conf secondary). delta_E2 is unchanged (0.005) and is to be re-set from the development lambda=0 dV_bal floor. 判断 28: with bootstrap_persons the R = 200 per-rep values are the person-bootstrap distribution; the interval is its (1-ci)/2 and (1+ci)/2 percentiles and the one-sided p is the share of values <= 0 (scripts/e2_summarise.py, output interval_method); about 3.3 hours on a Mac CPU.
